To what extent are the police effective in controlling crime?

Section D: Media

text: In most societies the police are employed to control and prevent crime by using a range of sanctions
and strategies. Despite this, people who commit corporate crimes are often not prosecuted. Also,
according to official crime statistics and self-report studies, females are less likely than males to
commit crime. However, not all sociologists believe that self-report studies are accurate.
